claim_boundary: static schema and semantic fixtures only; every ref, generation, controller, projection and return target here is synthetic fixture data. No domain command, semantic-domain handler, EventRecord, durable state, permission decision, mounted local controller, production UICommand row, GUI surface, or native/runtime result is proven. owner_current_projection is a pinned static owner test double and an explicitly unproven binding: it stands in for what an owner-local controller would select under its own authority, and copying a witness value into it never authenticates owner currentness. A null owner_current_projection is that same field carrying an absent selection, and the stale-refusal requirement on absence is bound to the field itself.

invalid.name: negative.settlement.details.success_on_absent_projection
invalid.why: The owner-selected current projection is absent at settlement time (owner_current_projection is null), so no presentation can have happened; the settlement must be the stale_projection refusal with a null owner_result, never a presented success.
